contexts.name: companion-background-jobs
contexts.description: Background job worker for long-running Athena tasks (codebase scan, memory curation, connector calls) that run without blocking the chat. Jobs follow a `queued → running → completed|failed` lifecycle, with atomic ownership transfer to prevent double-claim by concurrent workers. On completion a system episode is appended to the chat transcript so Athena's next turn sees the result. Includes orphan recovery on startup, per-job progress reporting via Tauri events, and 30-day retention prune of terminal rows.

contexts.name: companion-behavioral-memory
contexts.description: Implements the procedural and goal memory tiers. Procedural rules describe durable how-to behaviors Athena follows (e.g. 'lead with stale observability after long breaks') with scope-typed categories (chat/action/memory/build) and carry the same anti-hallucination provenance contract as facts. Goals track user-stated objectives with status (active/paused/completed/abandoned), priority, and an optional target date. The backlog module tracks open action items Athena has committed to, surfaced per-turn so she stays accountable.

contexts.name: companion-brain-repo
contexts.description: Core data layer for Athena's (the AI companion's) long-term brain — the graph of semantic facts, procedural rules, goals, rituals, and episodic memories stored as companion nodes and edges. Supports knowledge consolidation workflows where conversation episodes are distilled into durable facts the companion recalls across sessions.

contexts.name: companion-core-runtime
contexts.description: Core infrastructure and integration layer for the Athena companion system. Covers disk path resolution (`~/.personas/companion-brain/`), shared utilities (SHA-256, slugify, excerpt, short-id), model routing (which Claude model variant to use per request type), observability/tracing, generated UI anchors for the companion panel, wake-window scheduling, and the top-level companion module declaration. Also includes integration shims connecting Athena to the rest of the app: dev-mode overlay, dev sessions, athena_reaction event handler, connector and plugin adapters, and project context.

contexts.name: companion-episodic-memory
contexts.description: Implements the episodic memory tier — an append-only, markdown-on-disk log of every conversation turn and observed agent event. Each episode is written to `~/.personas/companion-brain/episodes/YYYY/MM/DD/` first (source of truth), then indexed into `companion_node` (kind='episode') and `companion_fts` for keyword retrieval. The typed-relation graph module (graph.rs) represents cross-node links (supports/contradicts/derives_from) backed by `companion_edge`, providing a traversal cache over the markdown frontmatter `links:` field.

contexts.name: companion-fleet-intelligence
contexts.description: Contains Athena's fleet-awareness intelligence layer: pattern recognition over fleet execution history, user decision profiling, profile synthesis for generating insight reports, and recall synthesis for summarizing brain state into a natural-language digest. Also covers the dashboard/cockpit composition ops (compose_dashboard, compose_cockpit, explain_in_cockpit) that let Athena generate personalized observability surfaces and the decisions module that tracks operator decision history for behavioral profiling.

contexts.name: companion-fleet-orchestration
contexts.description: Orchestration layer between Athena and the Fleet (parallel Claude Code workers). Operative memory is an in-process live record of what's happening now (which sessions are running, what Athena dispatched) distinct from brain/ which is the permanent historical record. The MCP module provides tool handlers (report_intent, checkpoint) that fleet workers call back through, plus a pending-approval queue. Fires `athena://orchestration/digest-changed` events so the frontend can pull a fresh live digest without polling.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri event: athena://orchestration/digest-changed; MCP tool endpoint

contexts.name: companion-hybrid-retrieval
contexts.description: Implements the hybrid retrieval layer that bundles memory into a `Recall` struct for each conversation turn. Combines recency (last 5 turns) with vector similarity (vec0 top-K via AllMiniLML6V2Q) across episodes, facts, procedurals, and doctrine. A dedicated kind-scoped doctrine lane prevents episode-heavy corpora from starving doctrine hits. Stable per-turn includes (active goals, top-importance procedurals, open backlog) ensure Athena always sees what she committed to regardless of query phrasing.

contexts.name: companion-identity-doctrine
contexts.description: Manages Athena's static constitution and evolving identity profile, plus the doctrine knowledge base (canonical app docs indexed as embeddings). The identity module implements anchored-diff editing (AppendBullet/ReplaceBullet/RemoveBullet ops) gated by approval cards so Athena can propose targeted profile updates without full-file rewrites. Doctrine ingests a curated 22-file allowlist of product docs chunked at H2/H3 boundaries, keyed by `(doc_path, heading_anchor)` for idempotent upserts. Templates provide the embedded constitution and identity markdown scaffolds.

contexts.name: companion-memory-pipeline
contexts.description: Implements the memory consolidation and embedding pipeline. Consolidation runs a separate ephemeral Claude CLI call over recent episodes and existing facts to propose semantic-fact updates (`add`/`update`/`contradict`) that land in `companion_consolidation_item` rows for human review. The embeddings module provides vec0 vector storage using AllMiniLML6V2Q (384-dim), with a model-guard that excludes stale embeddings from a swapped model, fuzzy dedup via cosine distance, and importance decay/prune lifecycle management.

contexts.name: companion-proactive-messaging
contexts.description: Implements Athena's proactive outreach system — nudges she generates on her own initiative without a user prompt. A 5-stage pipeline: trigger evaluators scan brain state to produce `Nudge` candidates; a quiet-hours guard suppresses delivery during focus/sleep windows; a daily budget cap (default 3) prevents spam; dedup prevents restacking the same trigger; and persistence writes to `companion_proactive_message`. Specialized trigger modules handle execution review, incident alerting, fleet operation wrap-ups, backlog aging, rollup digests, message triage, and scheduled future check-ins.

contexts.name: companion-semantic-memory
contexts.description: Implements the semantic memory tier: distilled facts about the user, projects, and world. Each fact has three persistence layers — markdown on disk (source of truth), a `companion_node` row (kind='fact'), and a `companion_fact` sidecar with typed metadata (scope, key, confidence, supersedes/contradicts). Enforces an anti-hallucination provenance contract: every fact write must cite ≥1 source episode ID. Also implements touch-last-seen, soft-delete (moves to `_deleted/`), and fact reinforcement for fuzzy dedup.

contexts.name: companion-session-orchestration
contexts.description: Manages Athena's multi-conversation chat sessions, spawning and resuming Claude CLI processes per turn via stream-json, parsing events, persisting turns as episodic memories, and dispatching structured ops from assistant replies. Each turn writes episodes to the brain, emits Tauri events for the UI, and supports autonomous continuation sequences up to a hard cap. The dispatcher module extracts JSON proposals from assistant text, validates allowed ops, and creates approval-card rows or fires auto-navigation events.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri events: companion://turn, companion://token, companion://stream-end; IPC commands via commands/companion/

contexts.name: companion-voice-synthesis
contexts.description: Text-to-speech engine abstraction for Athena's spoken replies. Ships two local engines: Kokoro (primary, curated high-quality voices via sherpa-onnx sidecar) and Pocket TTS (experimental zero-shot voice cloning). The mod.rs defines shared types (TtsEngineId, TtsSettings, TtsAudio) and validates text/voice-id inputs. Engine-specific modules handle sidecar invocation, catalog management (available voices with metadata), and one-click installer flows that download and extract the model packages to `~/.personas/companion-tts/`.

contexts.name: companion-voice-transcription
contexts.description: On-device speech-to-text for Athena's voice input using whisper.cpp via a sidecar binary. The mod.rs defines audio validation (WAV format, 16kHz/mono/16-bit PCM, size bounds) and language code validation. The catalog module lists available Whisper models with metadata; the downloader handles model acquisition; and whisper.rs handles sidecar process spawning per transcription call. Only local Whisper paths reach this module — the browser Web Speech Engine is handled entirely in the frontend.

contexts.name: dev-tools-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for Athena's Developer Tools plugin — dev memories (long-term learnings about codebases), dev run checkpoints (state between multi-step CLI sessions), and the dev tools backlog (capability gaps and self-promises Athena tracks). Enables Athena to maintain context across multiple autonomous development sessions.

contexts.name: glyph-command-panel
contexts.description: The command panel inside the Glyph that lets users compose and dispatch a one-shot execution with full connector/event/schedule/messaging configuration. A multi-row panel (messaging, tools, when) leads into a composer sub-system with dedicated picker modals for connectors, events, schedules, and messaging channels. Recipe suggestions are surfaced when eligibility criteria are met.

contexts.name: glyph-persona-card
contexts.description: The Glyph is the rich persona detail card surface used throughout the app (sidebar, overview, companion). It supports multiple layout modes (full, row strip, cinema, dialogue-cinema, edit face, sigil face, stage surface) and shows capability previews, activity strips, answer cards, dimension summaries, and a top bar. Layout state and compose config are managed by dedicated hooks.

contexts.name: persona-core-codex
contexts.description: The Persona Core Codex surface that displays and edits a persona's deep behavioral identity: archetype selection (9 archetypes with glyph data), polarity sliders, mentality card, trait grid, snapshot column, and a compact core badge. usePersonaCore manages saving and reading the personality snapshot; PersonaCoreModal is the full editing dialog.
